url_scheme: The URL must start with http(s)://
url_extras: The URL can't include a user, credentials, a query or a fragment
header_line: Header line {line} must look like "Name: value"
env_line: Environment line {line} must look like NAME=value (letters, digits and _ in the name)
proxy_scheme: The proxy must start with http(s):// or socks5://
model_context_int: Model {id}'s context window must be a whole number
model_effort_unsupported: Model {id}'s default thinking effort isn't one it supports
add_model: Check or add at least one model
default_unchecked: The default model must be one of the checked models
timeout_int: The timeout must be a whole number (ms)
compact_int: The auto-compact window must be a whole number
max_context_int: The max context must be a whole number
args_dash: Each extra argument must start with -
node_outdated: Persona on this computer needs an update
left_out_credential: Leaves out {names}, since keys and passwords aren't carried over.
left_out_shell: Leaves out {names}, since only the shell can work out the value.
left_out_computer: Leaves out {names}, since the value only fits that computer.
left_out_limit: Leaves out {names}, since a provider keeps at most {max}.
stays_elsewhere: {alias} stays: the new provider doesn't replace it on {computers}.
